beaches.name: Limanakia (B' Limanaki), Vouliagmeni
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established in two rocky coves between Vouliagmeni and Varkiza. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from the 2000s to 2022; Greek press listicles from 2024 and 2025 also name B' Limanakia. Reports describe a largely gay male crowd; no designation or signage is documented.
